summary: Build API governance, consent controls, and digital banking execution skills in 5 days. Ideal for advanced banking professionals.
lede: Digital banking and open banking connect customer channels with API-enabled services and governed third-party access. For banking professionals improving digital services and onboarding, this course covers API inventory mapping, consent and data-sharing controls, and third-party risk assessment to help structure and oversee these services.
audienceIntro: This digital banking and open banking course is designed for professionals who need to shape API-enabled services, govern third-party access, and improve digital customer journeys in regulated banking environments.
prerequisites: Advanced familiarity with banking operations, digital channels, or financial services product delivery is required. You should bring a working understanding of APIs, customer onboarding, KYC and AML controls, and basic information-security concepts. No coding is required for completion, but you should be prepared to interpret API documentation, control matrices, and workflow diagrams. The course assumes you can discuss operational processes, vendor dependencies, and governance decisions from your current role.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
